propositions: Rebar 0.11.0 minor release from main requires version bumps in pyproject.toml, server.json, uv.lock, and CHANGELOG.md curated entries dated 2026-08-06, validated through release guards, lint, typecheck, and full test suite before Gerrit submission and CI dispatch.
uv.lock must be regenerated during the 0.11.0 release to lock the root nava-rebar package version to 0.11.0; stale lock at 0.10.1 causes CI lock-installing job failures.

PyPI 0.11.0 wheel provenance verification uses the authoritative pypi-attestations tool with PEP 740 publish/v1 predicate, not GitHub gh attestation verify with SLSA predicates; docs/releasing.md currently prescribes the wrong verifier.

Release workflow dispatch from main with version=0.11.0 requires pypi environment approval, publishes wheel and sdist to PyPI with PEP 740 attestations, creates immutable GitHub Release v0.11.0, and updates MCP Registry and Homebrew tap.

All 27 codebase acceptance criteria and 14 operator-attested runtime/external criteria must pass before release closure, including receipt verification from PyPI, GitHub, Homebrew, and channel probe execution.
